items.fact: No power calibration of the confocal laser combiner's four lines (405, 488, 561, 640 nm) was found in any place listed under how. The prior project's own record says none existed there: no stored mW calibration anywhere, NIS's mW display is a user-entered table that was empty (CALIBRATED0..3 = 0), and volts -> mW was listed under 'still unknown'. The power meter available from 2026-09-02 was a standalone display, and no measurement taken with it on these lines is recorded.
items.how: Searched on 2026-09-24, read only. In C:\agentic_microscope, at main fbedef0, with the working tree identical for these files: kb/decisions/2026-09-02-lunf-first-light-measured-limits.md, sections 4, 5, 9 and 'Still unknown'; hardware/lunf_power.py, header; data/light_sources.yaml, entry LUN-F-XL, where power_at_sample_mw is empty for all four lines; config/lunf/*.py (four files); and kb/systems/current.md. Their content was read at main, and every line matching 'calibrat' or 'power meter' was kept if it also named a laser, the confocal path, a line wavelength or mW. Only three places matched: the 2026-09-02 record's 'there is none'; docs/02-knowledge-base.md, a schema placeholder ('measured mW filled in after calibration', and LaserCalibration.points staying empty); and docs/mhs-integration.md ('power_at_sample_mw still needs a power meter'). The rest were about the trap, pixel size or other devices. Also every commit message on all branches for 'calibrat', 'power meter' and 'mW', with no hit on the confocal lines' power; and the working tree, by filename, for *calib* and *power*. Those hits were a trap calibration script, calibration tests, validity/power.py, which names no laser or confocal line, and a pixel-size table (next item). In this repository: librarian_agent/kb/entries (only lunf_per_line_power_is_not_transmittable mentions the combiner's power, and it holds no calibration), and librarian_agent/kb/staging/devices.v0.json. NOT SEARCHED by this seat: the NIS-Elements installation and its device database on this computer. The prior project reports searching them on 2026-09-02 and finding every calibration record empty and no calibration XML or CSV under any Laboratory Imaging path; that is its search, not this seat's. Also not searched: lab notebooks or spreadsheets outside that repository beyond the Desktop filename in the next item, the power meter's own memory, and any vendor service record.

Measured there on 2026-09-02: PID 6544 killed, then 561 blinked when driven from Python.

items.fact: If a program driving the confocal combiner's blanking lines is killed rather than closed, a line it left open can stay open, with the fiber shutter open, and no software in this repository can close either. The barrier left is the confocal unit's own shutter, which Micro-Manager is refused from writing today, so the person moves it.
items.how: Composed from two prior-project readings and this repository's code. First, probe_lunf.py's blink creates and clears a digital-output task for every write, and the light stayed on between writes, so a line holds its level after the writing task is gone. That the level also survives the writing process dying is not measured. Second, the fiber shutter survives a kill (previous item). Third, lunf.py reaches neither the fiber shutter nor the unit's shutter, and micromanager.py refuses CSUW1-Shutter by name.
items.note: E5: an inference, not a measurement. Falsifier: kill the driving process with one line open, and see that line go dark on its own. The closed-versus-killed table is in microscope_agent/src/devices/lunf_live_checklist.md at 196c346.

items.fact: In the prior project, the combiner's lines mapped to DAQ Dev1 port 0 as 405 -> line2, 488 -> line4, 561 -> line6, 640 -> line8, with DAC indices 0-3. No combiner monitor is wired to any of the DAQ's 32 analog inputs, which all float to the rail. The DLL exports no shutter or status entry point.

items.fact: A confocal frame taken with the spinning disk stopped is a stationary pinhole grid at full brightness, 5-53x over all-off, so nothing looks wrong until the texture is checked. The off-centre power-spectrum peak over median, on a central crop of (line on - all off), was 25,978 to 210,347 in grid frames, against 129 in the one condition with no signal.

items.fact: After NIS was force-killed, Micro-Manager's configuration load did not return, twice: the dual-camera configuration (without its DAQ devices and startup preset) for about six minutes in run-20260924-009, and the Ti2 stand alone, with no camera, confocal unit, light engine or DAQ device, for about two minutes in run-20260924-010. The same stand devices loaded in about 3 s in run-20260924-008, after NIS had been closed normally. So what does not answer after the kill is the stand's own connection.
